title: 第9章 你的嘲讽我将其收下你的性命我要带走第10章 我的确杀不了你但是他呢
lines: 现在的你，不再是剑宗之人……”
萧雨薇表情冷漠，语带嘲讽。
萧诺看了眼前方地面上的那封文书，不禁笑道：“萧家小姐，还真的是神通广大，才时隔一天，就让天罡剑宗把我除名了。”
萧雨薇冷笑：“这是你自找，若你不去萧家闹事，独自找个地方苟且偷生，或许还能卑微的度过残生，可你偏偏跳出来……自寻死路……”
“好一个苟且偷生，好一个自寻死路……”
萧诺正视萧雨薇那高傲的面孔，冷声讥讽道：“萧家能有今天，可都是用我那滴天凰血换来的……就算是你尊贵的萧家小姐，当年也天天围着我嘘寒问暖，如今攀上了天罡剑宗的少宗主，就让你得意忘形了吗？”
面对萧诺的讽刺，萧雨薇不以为然。
“今时不同往日，三年前的你，有令家族崛起的希望，我自对你高看一眼。
但今天，你我之间，相差悬殊。
我‘寒星剑体’初成，就已崭露锋芒，介时剑体大成，未来修行，一日千里，自有得意忘形的资本……至于少宗主……”
萧雨薇话锋一顿，脸上的轻蔑更浓：“你和他更没有对比的资格，他位高权重，天赋卓绝，年纪轻轻，便是东荒最为杰出的一代剑王，哪怕你天凰血没有被夺，也依旧与他是云泥之别。”
看着萧雨薇傲慢得意的表情，萧诺的眼神变得尖锐了些许。
站在萧雨薇身后的萧永更是恶狠狠的喝斥道：“萧诺，别拿你自己和少宗主相提并论，你连给他提鞋的资格都没有，你只不过是我萧家养的一条狗……别说取你的天凰血，就算是要你的命，你也只能点头。”
这萧家姐弟二人的言语锋利无比，萧诺的怒意也是骤然涌动。
其冷冷的笑道：“萧家，我高攀不起……”
说罢，萧诺掠步探出，朝着前方冲去。
也就在这时，一道强盛剑气从天而降……
剑气入地，譬如一道霜星坠落在了萧诺的面前。
紊乱的剑流从中荡开，地表龟裂，只见一柄萦绕着赤光的长剑挡在了萧诺的前方。
萧家的众杀手皆是一惊。
“好强的剑气！”
“是谁？”
嗒！
沉稳的脚步自夜幕中传来，一道眉宇阴鸷的年轻身影踏足而出。
“是筑基境的剑修！”
有人惊呼道。
看着来人，萧家的一众杀手都是心有畏惧。
萧雨薇则是露出了得意的笑容，很明显，对方来自天罡剑宗。
“少炎剑，李流……奉少宗主之命，前来为萧雨薇师妹，清理门户！”
content_en:
Now you are no longer a member of the Sword Sect..."
Xiao Yuwei's expression was cold and her words were sarcastic.
Xiao Nuo looked at the document on the ground in front of him and couldn't help but smile: "Miss Xiao, she really has great magical powers. Just one day later, she asked Tiangang Sword Sect to remove me. "
Xiao Yuwei sneered: "You asked for it. If you didn't go to the Xiao family to cause trouble and found a place to live alone, you might be able to spend the rest of your life humbly, but you just jumped out... and asked for your own death..."
“It’s so easy to live in an ignoble existence, and it’s so good to seek death...”
Xiao Nuo looked squarely at Xiao Yuwei's arrogant face and sarcastically said: "The Xiao family is here today only because of a drop of my Heavenly Phoenix blood... Even your noble Miss Xiao family used to greet me every day, but now that you have become the young master of the Tiangang Sword Sect, have you got carried away? "
Faced with Xiao Nuo's sarcasm, Xiao Yuwei didn't take it seriously.
"Today is different from the past. Three years ago, you had the hope of making the family rise. I have a high regard for you.
But today, there is a huge difference between you and me.
My "Hanxing Sword Body" has already shown its edge when I first formed it. At this time, my sword body has reached its peak. In the future, my practice will be rapid and rapid, and I will have the capital to get carried away... As for the young sect leader..."
Xiao Yuwei paused, and the contempt on her face deepened: "You have no qualifications to compare with him. He has a high position, great talent, and a young age. He is the most outstanding sword king in the Eastern Wasteland. Even if your Tianhuang blood has not been taken away, you are still different from him. "
Seeing Xiao Yuwei's arrogant and proud expression, Xiao Nuo's eyes became a little sharper.
Xiao Yong, who was standing behind Xiao Yuwei, even scolded fiercely: "Xiao Nuo, don't compare yourself to the young sect master. You are not even qualified to carry his shoes. You are just a dog raised by my Xiao family... Let alone taking your Tianhuang blood, even if it costs your life, you can only nod. "
The words of the Xiao siblings were extremely sharp, and Xiao Nuo's anger suddenly surged.
He smiled coldly and said: "The Xiao family is beyond my reach..."
After saying that, Xiao Nuo stepped forward and rushed forward.
At this moment, a powerful sword energy descended from the sky...
“Bang! "
The sword energy entered the ground, like a frost star falling in front of Xiao Nuo.
The chaotic flow of swords swayed from it, the ground cracked, and a long sword lingering in red light was seen blocking Xiao Nuo's front.
All the killers of the Xiao family were shocked.
"What a strong sword energy! "
"Who is it? "
"..."
“Ta!
despair!
despair! "
Steady footsteps came from the night, and a young figure with sinister eyebrows stepped out.
“It’s a sword cultivator at the Foundation Establishment Realm! "
someone exclaimed.
Looking at the person coming, all the killers of the Xiao family were afraid.
Xiao Yuwei showed a proud smile. It was obvious that the other party came from Tiangang Sword Sect.
"Shao Yan Sword, Li Liu... came here to clean up the family for Junior Sister Xiao Yuwei on the orders of the Young Sect Leader! "
"Wow! "
title_en: Chapter 9 I will accept your ridicule. I will take your life away. Chapter 10 It is true that I can’t kill you, but what about him?
